title: Tap and it talks
summary: Make characters talk when you tap them or press a key. Learn signals, top-to-bottom order and costumes.
learn: Make a sprite do something when you tap it
Put blocks in order, top to bottom
Change how a sprite looks with costumes
Use a key as a signal

steps.title: Play first
steps.text: Fox and Robot are ready to talk. Press [[Run code]]. Then tap Fox, tap Robot, and press [space]. What does each one do?

checklist.text: Press [[Run code]], then tap and press keys

steps.why: Nothing happens until you tap or press a key. That is a <<signal>>.

steps.title: Sprites wait for a signal
steps.text: Only Fox has blocks now: ((Events#hat:click|when Fox clicked)) with a say block under it. The blocks under it run when you tap Fox.

predict.question: What happens when you tap Robot?
predict.explain: Robot has no blocks, so a tap on Robot does nothing. Only the blocks under when Fox clicked listen for a tap on Fox.

checklist.text: Make your guess
Press [[Run code]], then tap Robot and Fox

steps.why: A <<sprite>> only does what its own blocks say, when their signal comes.

steps.title: Top to bottom

labels: I do my blocks in order.

steps.text: Robot has three say blocks under one tap block. Each one says something for 1 second.

predict.question: You tap Robot. What does Robot say last?
predict.explain: Blocks run from top to bottom. Each say-for waits before the next one starts, so Three comes last.

checklist.text: Make your guess
Press [[Run code]], then tap Robot

steps.why: The computer reads your blocks like you read a page: from the top down.

steps.title: Costumes
steps.text: Fox has two <<costumes|costume>>: its first one and a happy one. ((Looks#scene_next_costume|next costume of sprite Fox)) puts on the next costume.

predict.question: Fox starts in its first costume. You tap Fox two times. Which costume is Fox wearing?
predict.explain: Tap 1: the happy costume. Tap 2: after the last costume, Fox starts again at the first one.

checklist.text: Make your guess
Press [[Run code]], then tap Fox two times

steps.why: Next costume goes round and round, like turning the pages of a tiny flip book.

steps.title: A key is a signal too
steps.coach: The key block is in Events. Tap it!
steps.text: Make Robot say Jump! when you press [space].

checklist.text: Add ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed))
Put ((Looks#scene_say_for|sprite Robot say Jump! for 2 seconds)) under it
Run it. Tap the game, then press [space]

hints: Pick Robot under the stage. Then drag ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)) out of {{Events}}.
Snap ((Looks#scene_say_for|sprite Robot say Jump! for 2 seconds)) from {{Looks}} under it, and type Jump!
steps.why: Taps, keys and the game starting are all signals. Each "when" block waits for its own one.

steps.title: What will Fox say?
steps.text: Read the blocks, then answer. (You can run it after.)

quiz.question: You tap Fox. What does Fox say?
quiz.explain: The block under when Fox clicked says Hello! for 2 seconds.

quiz.question: You tap Robot. What does Robot say?
quiz.explain: The block under when Robot clicked says Beep boop! for 2 seconds.

quiz.question: You tap Robot. What does Fox say?
quiz.explain: The blocks belong to Fox and listen for a tap on Fox. Tapping Robot does nothing.

steps.title: Snap it in
steps.text: Snap the loose say block under ((Events#hat:click|when Fox clicked)), so Fox talks when you tap it.

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Drag the say block by its left edge. Drop it just under the when block until it clicks in.

steps.title: Make Robot talk
steps.text: Make Robot say Beep! when you tap Robot.

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Pick Robot under the stage first. Then drag ((Events#hat:click|when Robot clicked)) out of {{Events}}.
Under it, add ((Looks#scene_say_for|sprite Robot say Beep! for 2 seconds)) from {{Looks}} and type Beep!

steps.title: What comes last?
steps.text: Fox says three things when you tap it.

quiz.question: You tap Fox and wait. What does Fox say last?
quiz.explain: Top to bottom: Ready, then Set, then Go! comes last.

quiz.question: You tap Fox and wait. What does Fox say first?
quiz.explain: The top block runs first, so Fox says Red first.

quiz.question: You tap Fox and wait. What does Fox say last?
quiz.explain: Top to bottom: Three, Two, then One comes last.

steps.title: The wrong one talks
steps.text: Tapping Robot should make Robot say Ouch!. But Fox talks instead! Fix the blocks.

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Look at the say block. Which sprite does it name?
Tap the sprite menu in the say block and choose Robot.

steps.title: Put the joke in order
steps.text: Fox’s joke is mixed up. Drag the say blocks so Fox says them in the right order: the question, the answer, then Ha ha!

fields.TEXT: Why did the robot take a nap?

expect.says: Why did the robot take a nap?

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Blocks run top to bottom. Which line should Fox say first?
Drag the question block to the top, just under the when block. Ha ha! goes last.

fields.TEXT: Why did the robot take a nap?

steps.title: Happy Fox
steps.text: When you tap Fox, Fox puts on its happy costume and says Yay!

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Use ((Looks#scene_costume_set|set sprite Fox costume)) and choose Fox happy. It is in {{Looks}}.
Then add ((Looks#scene_say_for|sprite Fox say Yay! for 2 seconds)) under it.

steps.title: Space party
steps.text: When you press [space], Fox says Party! and Robot says Beep beep!, both at the same time.

script.label: and Robot says Beep beep! at the same time

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: A say-for block waits before the next block starts. So Robot would talk 2 seconds late.
Give each sprite its own ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)). Then they both start when you press space.
steps.why: Two "when" blocks with the same signal both start at once. That is how two sprites can talk together.

steps.title: Count the costumes
steps.text: Fox has two costumes: the first one and a happy one. Each tap runs ((Looks#scene_next_costume|next costume of sprite Fox)).

quiz.question: Fox starts in its first costume. You tap Fox 3 times. Which costume is Fox wearing?
quiz.explain: Tap 1: happy. Tap 2: back to the first. Tap 3: happy again.

quiz.question: Fox starts in its first costume. You tap Fox 4 times. Which costume is Fox wearing?
quiz.explain: Happy, first, happy, first. After 4 taps Fox is back to the first one.

variants.text: Robot has three costumes: first, happy and jump. Each tap runs ((Looks#scene_next_costume|next costume of sprite Robot)).

quiz.question: Robot starts in its first costume. You tap Robot 4 times. Which costume is Robot wearing?
quiz.explain: Happy, jump, first, then happy again on tap 4.

steps.title: Your own talking card
steps.text: ★ Make a card that talks back! Fox, Robot and Rabbit are ready. Try the ideas below, in any order, then press Next step when you are happy with it.

checklist.text: Two friends talk when you tap them
Someone changes costume
Press [space] for a surprise

steps.title: Show what you know: tap to talk
steps.text: When you tap Fox, Fox says Good morning!

script.label: Tap Fox: Fox says Good morning!

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]] once

variants.text: When you tap Robot, Robot says Hello, world!

script.label: Tap Robot: Robot says Hello, world!

variants.text: When you tap Rabbit, Rabbit says Hop hop!

script.label: Tap Rabbit: Rabbit says Hop hop!

steps.title: Show what you know: in order
steps.text: Robot says three things when you tap it.

quiz.question: You tap Robot and wait. What does Robot say second?
quiz.explain: Top to bottom: Apple first, Banana second, Cherry last.

checklist.text: Answer once

variants.text: Robot has three costumes: first, happy and jump. Each tap runs ((Looks#scene_next_costume|next costume of sprite Robot)).

quiz.question: Robot starts in its first costume. You tap Robot 2 times. Which costume is Robot wearing?

variants.text: These blocks are under when Robot clicked.

quiz.question: You tap Robot. Who talks?
quiz.explain: The say block names Fox, so Fox talks when you tap Robot.

steps.title: Show what you know: together
steps.text: When you press [space], Fox says Ready! and Robot says Go!, both at the same time.

script.label: and Robot says Go! at the same time

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]] once

variants.text: When you press [space], Robot says Beep! and Fox puts on its happy costume.

finish.text: You made sprites listen for signals and talk in order!
remix: Make Rabbit tell a joke when you tap it.
Press space to make everyone change costume.
